anchors.anchorPolicy: Preserve aggregate neutral H/D after integer rounding; removal of role weights intentionally changes individual NPC HP/ATK

manifest.counterFamilyPolicy: Separate12comparison95%family:best-referencePIERCE_ARCANE minus other3types,BASE and APPEND separately,2models; not jointly95%with append family
manifest.effectBridgeScope: Construction-only actual prepared effectful control outside the12noneffect battle cases; no claim that confirmation battles have effects
manifest.factoryPolicy: Actual guardian(double,V3)/slinger(double,V3) with weight1; reconstruct immutable synthetic item from actual template, change only HP/attack parts, then forCombat on the same isolated unitseed. No writes to BattlePersonage final fields.
manifest.limitations: One fixed12cell500pair confirmation, no extensions; mirrors/model/variant cohorts correlated; fixed DEF is experimental, not a production decision. Append12-family and type12-family intervals each95%, not a joint95% claim across both families.
manifest.neutralPolicy: H=sum(maxHP/mean4damageTakenMultiplier); D=sum(maxProfileAttack*clampedCritExpectation*cappedFrequency); sorted reductions and team sums; skills/dodge/range access ignored in assessment but active in real combat
manifest.removed: No shared HP/ATK/DEF multiplier, no M/(2F/S) weights, no g/h/a/r or outcome fitting
manifest.roundingPolicy: Closedform targetH/naturalH and targetD/naturalD, no row weights; min1ceil naturalHP/ATK once; defense retained from actual factory at referenceDefMultiplier
manifest.seedPolicy: SHA256(namespace+'/'+groupId+'/'+pair), first48BE; no model/variant. GEN constructs players then draws one48bit unitseed per NPC; template/rebuild replay that unitseed. SAME/CROSS and countertwins share NPC IDs/gauges; BASE/APPEND only player prefix promised.
